video_title: ROOMMATES SHOW LIVE PT. 2 🍎 Spike Lee, Jimmy Fallon and the Wives Share Knicks' Playoff Run Stories

quotes.speaker: Spike Lee
quotes.summary_phrase: Spike Lee on the power of sports to unite New York City
quotes.excerpt: Sports brings people together. And New York City was together.
quotes.quote: I just want to thank you guys. I was so happy when we came through and did it. And here's the thing about sports: sports brings people together. And New York City was together. And it's amazing, hugging total strangers. And then you just want to keep going, quick, just say, 'Knicks in five' and keep going. It's not a conversation, 'Knicks in five', 'Knicks in five', boom, boom, boom, and it's all love. And so, thank you for bringing New York City together. Thank you. And sports is one of the few things that can do that.

quotes.speaker: Spike Lee
quotes.summary_phrase: Spike Lee on his long-standing history as a Knicks season ticket holder
quotes.excerpt: I've been a season ticket holder since Pat Ewing's rookie year.
quotes.quote: I've been a season ticket holder since Pat Ewing's rookie year. But I was not courtside, though. So every year, back then, the Garden, every section had a different color. So I started in green, then I moved down to yellow and orange. Then I got the word from someone who worked in the Garden, said, 'Spike, because they gave away those tickets, you couldn't buy them.' I got the inside word they're going on sale, so I got it.

quotes.speaker: Jalen Brunson
quotes.summary_phrase: Jalen Brunson on the intensity of playing at Madison Square Garden
quotes.excerpt: I've been a part of some loud moments in the Garden.
quotes.quote: I've been a part of some loud moments in the Garden. I've been a part of Dante's three. I've been a part of the night when I first became an All-Star. That night was loud. Game 1 of the Eastern Conference Finals this year was loud as hell. When people actually say, 'The Garden was shaking,' you hear that all the time, but Game 4 of the Finals, the Garden was literally, I sat down in my seat and it felt like it was a massage chair. It felt like it was moving. It was moving. So, to play in this city is unlike any other and I can't explain what that means to me.

quotes.speaker: Josh Hart
quotes.summary_phrase: Josh Hart on the importance of being healthy for games at the Garden
quotes.excerpt: You wanted to be healthy against the Knicks in the Garden.
quotes.quote: No matter what team you were on, you wanted to be healthy against the Knicks in the Garden. That was the one game that you look at on the calendar and you're like, 'That's the one.' It don't matter if you might be playing Brooklyn before that, you're going to sit out playing against Brooklyn because you got to make sure you're healthy for playing in the Garden.

quotes.speaker: Spike Lee
quotes.summary_phrase: Spike Lee on the work ethic required to succeed in New York
quotes.excerpt: You live in New York, you got to work.
quotes.quote: Go to work. Hard work. Got to work, got to work. I mean, you live in New York, you got to work. And those guys, they show us what we can do, what we can overcome. One of them games, I was like, 'There's a shot of me, one of them clips, I'm like this.' I'm not going to lie, what was it, down by 29? I was like, 'Damn.' But I didn't give up, though. But I was praying. In fact, I got some of these championship rings here, Red Holzman's ring, and I had it in my hand, I was praying, but the rings were inside my hand.

quotes.speaker: Spike Lee
quotes.summary_phrase: Spike Lee on his desire to see the Sixers lose
quotes.excerpt: I don't want the Sixers in the locker room. I want them to see the flag raised.
quotes.quote: I hope the Sixers watch, I don't want the Sixers in the locker room. I want them to see the flag raised. LeBron can watch that, I think. He's going to watch that.

quotes.speaker: Jalen Brunson
quotes.summary_phrase: Jalen Brunson clarifies the 'player-only meeting' rumor
quotes.excerpt: It wasn't a player-only meeting. Before the coaches walk into the locker room, I said my piece.
quotes.quote: It wasn't a player-only meeting. Before the coaches walk into the locker room after the game, I quickly said my piece and then Mike walked in. It wasn't like I said, 'We need to meet for an hour.' No, I said, 'No, I have a couple minutes to say what I have to say.' I said what I said, Mike came in, said what he had to say, and we moved on.

quotes.speaker: Jalen Brunson
quotes.summary_phrase: Jalen Brunson on the turning point of the Knicks' season
quotes.excerpt: The part that defines us the most as a team is when we were Game 4.
quotes.quote: The part that defines us the most as a team is when we were Game 4. We say it all the time, Josh missed a layup, 'Haha, yeah, funny.' But there was a foul and Josh is on the ground, his head was in his hands. And me, Cat, and Jose ran up to him and said, 'Yo, get the hell up, we're good, move on, move on.' And Josh moved on. And Josh got a key stop later that in a couple possessions later. And I think that part, that scene defined us as a team and I'll never forget that part because we quickly could have crumbled, but we did it.

quotes.speaker: Jalen Brunson
quotes.excerpt: He's probably the reason we won, honestly.
quotes.quote: He's probably the reason we won, honestly. Cursed everyone else besides us, all the way to the championship. So, we owe him a lot. We owe him a lot. And for you that I know you don't really know, Danhausen is a wrestler in WWE, and he put a curse on everybody but us, and we won the championship.

quotes.speaker: Jalen Brunson
quotes.summary_phrase: Jalen Brunson on the team's vibrational frequency and success
quotes.excerpt: We are a man of increase and I just want to know how did you carry that vibrational frequency.
quotes.quote: We are a man of increase and I just want to know how did you carry that vibrational frequency that you guys had at Villanova and carry it on to win a freaking NBA Finals for the New York Knicks? I want to know that, man, because you two guys are a man of increase and I just want to know how did you carry that vibrational frequency and what did it take for you to instill those qualities in the teammates around you?

quotes.speaker: Josh Hart
quotes.summary_phrase: Josh Hart on the bond between teammates who have faced adversity
quotes.excerpt: We love each other as brothers first and teammates second.
quotes.quote: I think all of the adversity that we went through for what, those four years, the last couple years, it all, we love each other as brothers first and teammates second. And I think when you have a bond with people that you forge through tough times and adversity and the dog days, it carries on for a lifetime. So whether it's 5, 10 years down the road, or 50 years down the road, we're going to have that relationship and that friendship always.

quotes.speaker: Josh Hart
quotes.summary_phrase: Josh Hart on Mikal Bridges' sacrifice for the team
quotes.excerpt: He was willing to sacrifice his own individual performances and his own individual accolades.
quotes.quote: He was willing to sacrifice his own individual performances and his own individual accolades and those kind of things for the betterment of the team. And I feel like he really was with Landry at the core of that word sacrifice that we really needed to win this thing. So, I really want to give him love and highlight him because we've asked him to sacrifice more than anybody else on the roster.

quotes.speaker: Jimmy Fallon
quotes.summary_phrase: Jimmy Fallon on his experience as a Knicks fan at Madison Square Garden
quotes.excerpt: I ended up with crazy tickets that is so close to the team.
quotes.quote: I ended up with crazy tickets that is so close to the team. And I'm actually sitting this close to you. And then my, you know, Mike Brown is over there yelling, and he's screaming like different plays, like, 'Go, go, go, do volcano, volcano!' Or he's yelling whatever, some code name for a play. And I'm like, 'I'm nervous, I don't want to freak anyone out.' And so, I was there for, you know, the season opener, I was there for a bunch of games, but then I was there for the playoffs and and and Cleveland. And you were down by like 22. Thank you, 22, yeah. And it was not looking great, but then you came back, one of the best games ever. It was unbelievable.

quotes.speaker: Jimmy Fallon
quotes.summary_phrase: Jimmy Fallon on the importance of the Knicks' championship win to the city
quotes.excerpt: Thank you for the gift of giving us that championship, that win, that memory.
quotes.quote: I have to thank you again. I want to thank Leon Rose, I want to thank Jim Dolan, I want to thank you guys for coming. You were the first, we did the first show before you even did the ticker tape parade. We booked you guys with like 32 hours notice. And I can't thank you enough. We called you and said, 'Would you come on the show if you won?' And your people said, 'We don't even want to talk about that. We're just focused on the game, we don't even want to mention it, but we love Jimmy, but yeah, we'll talk about it after you won.' I watched the game, I was with Lauren, and I called, we called you and they said, 'Jalen's in, Josh is in.' I'm like, 'Fantastic, that's awesome.'
